fixed.summary: Moves frames: a background image layer counts as the ground under a text only where it paints, placed as og-render places it: an image in a plate's corner (a filigree) no longer makes the whole plate an authored ground, so text on the plate's thin fill takes the style's --tag-halo over the scene (fantasy's done quest step on its HUD plate read 2.3:1 over a bright sky).
